text: Held W 14s pushing at 15m from terrace; boulder slipped away and is now '40 m behind you' while I walked on up. No message said it slipped.
Patching works nicely: held E 5s on router (43%) -> healthy 99%. Prompt explains rot reason ('deprecated API, a call it makes is going away') - good flavour.

Third time the boulder slipped off my push: it drifts sideways (left) while I hold W, contact breaks and it rolls straight back down past me to the trailhead ('7 m behind you'). Steering the push is very hard to read in first person; there is no indicator of push direction or contact.

Boulder escapes again within 2-3 s of pushing, even in V (behind) view while aligned: it drifts left, contact breaks, it rolls back to the trailhead. ~6 fps here (frame 3254 after ~9 min, free clock), so coarse steps may be making contact flaky. 10 minutes in and best progress is 12 m of 33.

'pt hold w 3.2' returned 'pt: no answer to event within 60s'; afterwards Sisyphus had walked 44 m past the boulder into the town and it was night - the W key appears to have stayed held for a minute (or the game stalled). Health fell 69%->52% meanwhile, storage at 8%.

At night in first person, right up against the boulder, the screen is almost pure black: can't see the boulder, the module labels or where the crosshair is. The prompt still says 'Face the boulder and walk into it' so I can't tell if I'm on it.

With the crosshair on router (prompt 'Hold E to patch', first person, touching the boulder), 'pt hold e 5/6/8' did nothing: no progress bar under the prompt mid-hold, router kept falling 47%->35%. The very same action worked earlier at the trailhead in daylight. Other keys (F1, V, W) still register. No feedback says why patching is refused.

Weight bar maxed: 'too heavy to push uphill' (red). Two modules DOWN, one 'far side' one 'on top' - neither reachable at the trailhead, where the boulder cannot be rolled downhill to turn it. Feels like a soft-lock: can't push, can't reach the broken modules.

With weight 'heavy' (not 'too heavy'), holding W while lined up only moves it ~1 m then 'It is rolling back down!' appears and it slides back to the trailhead while W is still held. Combined with the unreachable DOWN modules (on top / far side) this is a death spiral: users 10 -> 0 and no way to get the weight down.

The HUD said storage was 'on top' and seemed unreachable; from the uphill side, looking slightly right at chest height, the crosshair found storage and it patched fine (0->100%). The position words (on top / far side / left / right) were hard to map to where to stand or aim.
Text mismatch: prompt under crosshair says 'router: aging, no issue yet (5%)' while the HUD lists router as an open issue 'rotting 5%'. At 5% it is clearly an issue.

Router patched to 100%, and within ~20 s it has a new issue ('dependency drift', -35%/min) at 98% - while the prompt says 'Nothing to patch' for it. Issues re-appear faster than I can walk around the boulder to fix them; 3 open issues at version 0.0, before the first release.

HUD says core is 'facing you' at 18% and dropping 38%/min, but every way I aim the crosshair (several looks up/down/left/right, stepping back) the prompt only finds ui. In first person at dusk the modules have no labels and look alike, so I can't find the one I'm told is facing me. Small 'pt look' moves (<100 px) also often seemed not to turn the view at all.

Positive: Q sit hides the HUD and shows 'The boulder is still. For a moment, so are you.' over the town at night - a lovely beat. Writing throughout (intro text, rot reasons like 'a dependency fell three majors behind') is strong.
